title: Tech Ops Engineering II-SUPPORT SERVICES-CTO - In House Engineering
description:
**Job Title: Production Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) – Digital Payments**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly technical and driven **Production SRE Engineer** to manage and monitor mission\-critical payment platforms including **UPI, IMPS, and Payment Hub systems** **\& various Payment Applications** .


The role focuses on ensuring **high availability, low latency, and seamless transaction experience** for customers. The incumbent will collaborate with **cross\-functional teams (Engineering, Business, Compliance)** and external regulators ( **RBI, NPCI** ) to maintain resilient and scalable payment infrastructure.  



**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Support \& Incident Management**

* Provide **L2/L3 production support** for UPI, IMPS, and Payment Hub platforms **\& various Payment Applications** .
* Diagnose, triage, and resolve **transaction failures, timeouts, and API disruptions** .
* Lead and participate in **Major Incident Management (MIM)** calls and ensure timely stakeholder communication.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets via **Jira, ServiceNow** .
* Provide **regular updates to internal stakeholders and regulatory bodies (NPCI/RBI)** during critical issues.

**Reliability Engineering \& RCA**

* Perform deep\-dive **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** for recurring payment and system issues.
* Implement **preventive and corrective measures** to improve system stability.
* Drive **SRE best practices** including error budgets, SLIs/SLOs, and system resilience.
* Experience in managing DR Drills \& Documentations.
* Reviewing the SOPs \& its relative documentations.

**Monitoring, Observability \& System Engineering**

* Monitor key performance indicators:
	+ Transaction success rates
	+ Latency and response times
	+ Failure trends and retries
* Build and maintain dashboards using:
	+ **ELK Stack, Grafana, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus**
* Establish proactive alerting and anomaly detection mechanisms.
* Work closely with engineering teams to design and optimize:
	+ High\-throughput payment switches
	+ Routing logic
	+ Settlement and reconciliation systems
* Understand and support **UPI architecture, IMPS rails, and payment orchestration layers \& various Payment Applications** .
* Trace end\-to\-end transaction lifecycle across distributed systems.

**External Partner \& Regulatory Coordination**

* Coordinate with **NPCI, partner banks, and TPAPs** during outages, reconciliation issues, or network disruptions.
* Lead integrations and ensure seamless onboarding of ecosystem participants.
* Ensure compliance with:
	+ **RBI guidelines and data localization mandates**
	+ **NPCI operational and technical standards**

**Technical Skills \& Expertise**

**Payments Domain Knowledge**

* Strong expertise in:
	+ **UPI architecture and flows**
	+ **IMPS rails**
	+ **Payment gateway / switch systems**
	+ **Payment Hub orchestration \& various Payment Applications.**

**Core Technical Skills**

* Advanced **SQL proficiency** (joins, aggregations, stored procedures)
* Strong hands\-on experience in:
	+ **Linux/UNIX systems administration**
	+ **Shell scripting**
* Ability to:
	+ Read , Write and interpret All types documentation (SOPs, workflows, etc.)
	+ Understand database schemas
	+ Analyse system architecture and latency

**Monitoring \& Observability Tools**

* Hands\-on expertise with:
	+ ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
	+ Grafana, Prometheus
	+ Splunk, Datadog

**DevOps \& Cloud**

* Experience with:
	+ CI/CD pipelines, Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Cloud platforms:
	+ **AWS / GCP / Azure**

**Key Competencies**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* High ownership in production environments
* Ability to work under pressure in real\-time systems
* Strong stakeholder communication and coordination
* Focus on reliability, scalability, and performance
* Must have can do, takes initiative, Drives end to end deliverables.
* Proactive, solution\-oriented mindset with ownership to resolve production issues under pressure.
* Ability to clearly articulate incidents, updates, and RCA to stakeholders, leadership, and regulators.
* Works effectively with cross\-functional teams (engineering, product, partners, regulators).
* Structured thinking to diagnose complex system failures and drive long\-term fixes.
* Ability to stay calm and effective during high\-severity incidents and critical outages.
* Knowledge of PCI\-DSS compliance, Financial data governance \& security best practices
* Quickly adapts to changing technologies, incidents, and regulatory requirements in a fast\-evolving payments ecosystem.
* Precision in analysing logs, transactions, and system behaviour to avoid critical errors in production.
* Effectively manage multiple incidents, tasks, and escalations in a high\-pressure environment.
* Ability to handle expectations and coordinate with internal teams, partners, and regulators efficiently.
* Takes ownership to make quick, informed decisions during outages or critical production incidents \& communications to various Stake holders including Regulatory.

title: Technical Lead
description:
We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Head who can take ownership of our overall technology and development function.

The person will be responsible for overseeing ongoing development, reviewing technical implementation, solving complex integration requirements, building APIs and webhooks, managing server and cloud infrastructure, and ensuring that all technology systems work reliably with our marketing, CRM, analytics, and third\-party platforms.

This is not a purely managerial role. The ideal candidate should be technically strong enough to understand, review, troubleshoot, design, and implement solutions independently when required.

The candidate should have strong experience with APIs, webhooks, server\-side integrations, cloud infrastructure, databases, CRM integrations, marketing APIs, conversion tracking, CAPI, offline conversions, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Development \& Technical Oversight

\- Oversee the development team and monitor the progress and quality of ongoing projects.

\- Review technical architecture, code quality, development practices, and implementation.

\- Understand existing applications, websites, dashboards, portals, and backend systems.

\- Identify technical issues and provide practical solutions.

\- Review developers' work and ensure projects are delivered according to requirements.

\- Take ownership of critical technical tasks when the development team requires support.

\- Ensure proper documentation of APIs, integrations, architecture, credentials, environments, and deployment processes.

\- Establish technical standards and best practices across projects.

2\. API Development \& Integration

\- Design, develop, integrate, and maintain REST APIs and other required APIs.

\- Create APIs based on business, product, CRM, and marketing requirements.

\- Develop and manage webhooks for real\-time data transfer and event\-based communication.

\- Integrate third\-party APIs, SaaS platforms, CRMs, payment systems, analytics platforms, and marketing platforms.

\- Handle authentication methods such as API keys, OAuth, tokens, JWT, etc.

\- Understand API request/response structures, JSON, HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, rate limits, and error handling.

\- Troubleshoot failed API calls, data mismatches, authentication issues, and integration failures.

\- Build middleware or backend services where required to connect multiple platforms.

3\. Marketing Technology \& Tracking Integrations

A strong understanding of MarTech and performance marketing integrations is mandatory.

The candidate should be able to work closely with the marketing and performance marketing teams to implement and troubleshoot:

\- Meta Conversions API (CAPI)

\- Meta Pixel

\- Google Ads Conversion Tracking

\- Google Ads Offline Conversion Tracking

\- Google Ads API / Data Manager integrations

\- Google Analytics 4

\- Google Tag Manager

\- CRM integrations

\- Lead tracking and lead lifecycle integrations

\- Click ID tracking such as GCLID, FBCLID and other attribution parameters

\- UTM tracking

\- Server\-side tracking

\- Web\-to\-CRM integrations

\- CRM\-to\-ad\-platform integrations

\- Conversion and event APIs

\- Postback integrations

\- S2S tracking

\- Affiliate tracking integrations

\- Webhook\-based lead and conversion transfer

\- Offline conversion uploads

\- Lead status and revenue/value feedback to advertising platforms

The candidate should understand how a lead moves from:

Ad → Landing Page → Tracking → CRM → Sales/Conversion → Revenue → Marketing Platform

and should be able to build or troubleshoot the technical infrastructure required at each stage.

4\. CRM \& Data Integrations

\- Integrate websites, landing pages, CRM systems, marketing platforms, and internal systems.

\- Build APIs and webhooks for lead creation, lead updates, status changes, and conversion events.

\- Ensure accurate transfer of lead information between systems.

\- Implement two\-way data synchronization where required.

\- Maintain unique identifiers and event IDs to prevent duplicate conversions.

\- Build systems for passing revenue, transaction, deposit, purchase, or other conversion values back to advertising platforms.

\- Work with marketing teams to ensure accurate attribution and reporting.

5\. Server \& Cloud Infrastructure

\- Manage and understand server environments and cloud infrastructure.

\- Work with platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Cloudflare, or equivalent infrastructure.

\- Understand domains, DNS, SSL, CDN, hosting, databases, storage, networking, and server configuration.

\- Manage application deployment and production environments.

\- Monitor server performance, uptime, logs, errors, and resource utilization.

\- Troubleshoot server\-side issues affecting websites, APIs, applications, and integrations.

\- Implement appropriate security measures for APIs and backend systems.

\- Work with developers and external infrastructure teams when required.

6\. Database \& Backend

\- Strong understanding of backend architecture and databases.

\- Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases.

\- Understand database structures, relationships, queries, indexing, and data integrity.

\- Ensure reliable storage and transfer of lead, customer, transaction, and conversion data.

\- Troubleshoot database\-related issues and performance problems.

\- Design appropriate data structures for API and integration requirements.

7\. Technical Problem Solving

\- Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues.

\- Diagnose problems across frontend, backend, APIs, servers, databases, and third\-party platforms.

\- Identify whether an issue is related to code, server configuration, API, tracking, CRM, cloud infrastructure, or third\-party systems.

\- Work with developers to resolve bugs and production issues quickly.

\- Take ownership of technical incidents until resolution.

8\. Technology Planning \& Architecture

\- Evaluate existing technology infrastructure and recommend improvements.

\- Design scalable technical solutions for new projects.

\- Select appropriate technologies, APIs, services, and infrastructure based on project requirements.

\- Review third\-party tools before implementation.

\- Ensure systems are scalable, secure, maintainable, and properly documented.

\- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive technical and operational processes.

Required Technical Skills

Backend \& APIs

\- REST APIs

\- API development and integration

\- Webhooks

\- JSON

\- HTTP/HTTPS

\- OAuth 2\.0

\- JWT / API authentication

\- API security

\- Error handling and logging

Programming

Strong hands\-on knowledge of at least one backend language/framework, such as:

\- Node.js / Express

\- PHP / Laravel

\- Python / Django / FastAPI

\- Java / Spring

\- .NET / C\#

Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript would be an advantage.

Cloud \& Infrastructure

\- AWS / Google Cloud / Azure

\- Linux

\- Server management

\- DNS

\- SSL

\- CDN

\- Cloudflare

\- Hosting and deployment

\- Basic networking

\- Monitoring and logging

\- CI/CD

Database

\- MySQL / PostgreSQL

\- MongoDB or other NoSQL databases

\- Database design

\- Query optimization

\- Data security and integrity

Marketing Technology

Hands\-on experience with:

\- Meta Pixel \& CAPI

\- Google Ads Conversion Tracking

\- Google Ads Offline Conversions

\- Google Analytics 4

\- Google Tag Manager

\- CRM integrations

\- Server\-side tracking

\- S2S integrations

\- Postbacks

\- Webhooks

\- UTM and attribution tracking

\- GCLID / FBCLID and similar tracking parameters

\- Conversion APIs

Integration Experience

Experience integrating platforms such as:

\- CRMs

\- Marketing automation platforms

\- Payment gateways

\- Analytics platforms

\- Advertising platforms

\- Affiliate networks

\- Lead management systems

\- WhatsApp / communication APIs

\- Internal business applications

\- Third\-party SaaS platforms

Leadership Responsibilities

\- Manage and mentor the development team.

\- Allocate technical tasks and monitor delivery.

\- Review development timelines and identify bottlenecks.

\- Conduct technical reviews of major projects.

\- Ensure developers follow proper coding, deployment, security, and documentation practices.

\- Coordinate with marketing, sales, operations, and management teams.

\- Convert business requirements into practical technical solutions.

\- Work with external developers, vendors, and technology partners when required.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is someone who can both manage technology and get their hands dirty technically.

You should be comfortable going from a business requirement such as:

«"We need every qualified lead from the CRM to be sent back to Meta and Google with the correct campaign, click ID, lead status, and conversion value."»

to understanding exactly:

Where the data originates → how it is stored → which API/webhook is required → how authentication works → how the data is transformed → how it is sent → how errors are handled → how the conversion is verified.

Similarly, if a developer says an integration cannot be completed because "the API isn't working," you should be able to investigate the API documentation, inspect requests/responses and logs, identify the actual problem, and guide or implement the solution.

**Qualifications**

\- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

\- 6\+ years of relevant technical experience.

\- Strong backend development experience.

\- Strong API and third\-party integration experience.

\- Hands\-on experience with cloud/server infrastructure.

\- Experience managing developers or a technical team.

\- Strong understanding of marketing technology and conversion tracking.

\- Experience working with CRM and advertising platform integrations.

\- Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

**Key Performance Areas**

Success in this role will be measured by:

\- Quality and reliability of technical implementations

\- Successful API and third\-party integrations

\- Stability of production systems

\- Accuracy of marketing and conversion tracking

\- Reduction in technical issues and integration failures

\- Development team productivity and delivery

\- API/webhook reliability

\- Server and cloud uptime

\- Security and scalability of systems

\- Speed of resolving critical technical issues

**What We Are Looking For**

Must Have:

\- Strong backend development knowledge

\- API development and integration

\- Webhook implementation

\- CRM integration

\- Server/cloud knowledge

\- Database knowledge

\- Meta CAPI

\- Google Ads conversion/offline conversion integration

\- GTM and GA4

\- Server\-side tracking

\- Strong troubleshooting skills

\- Ability to manage and review developers

\- Willingness to remain hands\-on technically

**Good to Have:**

\- AWS / GCP certification

\- DevOps experience

\- Docker

\- CI/CD

\- Cloudflare

\- Affiliate/postback tracking

\- Fintech/e\-commerce/ad\-tech experience

\- Experience with high\-volume lead and conversion data

\- Experience building internal automation systems

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Technical Head who can own the complete technical ecosystem, from development and APIs to servers, cloud infrastructure, CRM, marketing integrations, tracking, and automation.

The person should be a technical problem solver first and a team manager second, with the ability to understand business requirements, architect the solution, guide developers, and personally implement critical integrations when required.

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Have you managed or mentored a development team? If yes, how many members and in what capacity?
* Are you a immediate joiner?
* Do you have hands\-on experience with marketing/tracking integrations such as Meta CAPI, Google Ads Conversion Tracking (including offline conversions), GA4, and GTM? Please briefly describe your experience.
* Which backend language/framework are you most proficient in (Node.js, PHP/Laravel, Python, Java, .NET, etc.), and how many years have you worked with it?
* How many years of experience do you have building and integrating REST APIs and webhooks with third\-party platforms (CRM, payment gateways, marketing platforms, etc.)?

Work Location: In person

title: Fund Services.Operations Analyst
description:
**About Citco:**

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front\-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.


**About the Team \& Business Line:**

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.


  
**Your Role:**

* Coordinate month\-end collateral interest process between counter\-parties
* Instruct collateral and treasury transfer payments via SWIFT
* Prepare expense payments in Æxeo Treasury
* Agree and process over\-the\-counter (OTC) payments on behalf of clients
* Reviewing vendor platforms (such as Omgeo CTM, Traiana, Markit Trade Manager), PB matching portals and recaps on Trade Date
* Responsible for listed securities settlements via Prime Broker platforms, ensuring trades are pre\-matched and subsequently settle on the market between the counterparty and PB
* You will be responsible for the review, exception processing, break escalation/resolution and subsequent affirm/confirm of trade between the client and executing counterparty.
* You will assist with training and development of junior members of the team
* May work on special projects as needed
* Work with internal stakeholders/client in a professional manner to resolve any open issues

  
**About You:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or other quantitative subjects
* Knowledge of various different fund types
* Strong Customer Service and analytical and problem solving skills
* Committed team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Detail focused with the ability to multi\-task
* Ability to learn new systems and source information from numerous systems
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Adaptive, flexible professional style, capable of working in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Strong computer skills, with proficiency in Excel and Word, and aptitude to learn new skills
* Ability to organize, prioritize tasks and work in a deadline\-oriented environment
* Comfortable communicating with clients and counterparties via e\-mail and phone
* Experience/exposure to a cash settlements role not essential but would be of benefit
* Experience/exposure to ISDA Bi\-Lateral agreements and the collateral process not essential but would be of benefit
* Experience/exposure to financial instruments such as equities, bonds, equity swaps, FX, futures and OTC products not essential but would be of benefit.

**Skills and Behaviors You'll Bring:**  

  

**Building Future Readiness** – Demonstrates resilience by adapting well to change and is committed to improving knowledge and skills for the future.
  

  

**Delivering Client Excellence** – Partners with internal and external clients to understand needs, develop solutions and deliver an excellent client experience.
  

  

**Problem Solving \& Decision Making** – Demonstrates Data Literacy to analyze issues, identify practical solutions, and make informed decisions while taking responsibility for outcomes.
  

  

**Building Relationships** – Builds trusted relationships in an inclusive way. Positively influences outcomes while strengthening working relationships.
  

  

**Emotional Intelligence** – Demonstrates self\-awareness in identifying emotions, understanding triggers, and choosing appropriate behavior for the circumstance. Recognizes when biases may be impacting decisions. Seeks to understand and empathizes with others’ emotions and perspectives.
  

  

**Managing Risk** – Commits to protecting Citco by being aware of internal and external risks, thinking ahead to understand how those risks could affect people, processes or outcomes. Takes proactive steps using sound judgement to support safe and effective decision making. Values and promotes a strong risk culture.
  

  

**AI \& Digital Literacy** – Demonstrated ability to leverage AI\-powered tools and evolving digital technologies to enhance productivity, efficiency, and quality of work
  

  

**Learn more** about Citco's expected skills, behaviors, and the hiring process at *Careers FAQ*  

  

**Our Benefits**  



Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.


We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.


Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**About Kaseya**



Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.



Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.



Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.



We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.



At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

 **Position Summary**



Kaseya is seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer – DevTest / QA Automation to design, build, and maintain robust automated testing capabilities across enterprise software platforms.



This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on test automation and engineering quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong programming background and be capable of building test libraries, automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and large scale automated test suites.



The role requires an engineer who can leverage AI assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate automation, analyze existing codebases, generate and validate test scenarios, and rapidly expand automated coverage. The candidate should be comfortable working across application code, test infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and production troubleshooting.



The successful candidate will be able to take an existing codebase and, with limited direction, deliver hundreds of meaningful automated test cases within weeks, while maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, utilities, and reusable automation components.
* Build comprehensive automated test suites for enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, services, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Write production\-quality code to automate functional, integration, regression, API, and system\-level testing.
* Analyze existing application codebases and rapidly identify opportunities for automated test coverage.
* Develop and execute large\-scale automation initiatives capable of delivering hundreds of automated test cases in a short timeframe.
* Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents extensively to accelerate test development, test generation, code analysis, debugging, and automation engineering.
* Validate AI\-generated code and test cases through appropriate engineering practices, including code review, execution, debugging, and test\-result analysis.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and test execution infrastructure.
* Work with CI/CD runners, build systems, deployment pipelines, test environments, and automation reporting.
* Develop automation that can run reliably in continuous integration and deployment environments.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, application issues, environment problems, and production defects using logs, metrics, traces, code, and system behavior.
* Participate in production troubleshooting and issue reproduction, including supporting incidents or reproducing customer issues outside standard working hours when required.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, DevOps, operations, and other QA/DevTest engineers to identify quality risks and improve engineering practices.
* Contribute to improvements in testability, observability, reliability, performance, and maintainability of the product.
* Identify gaps in existing test coverage and proactively create automation to prevent regression.
* Review application and test code and provide technical feedback on quality, maintainability, reliability, and automation effectiveness.
* Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12\+ years of software engineering, SDET, DevTest, or QA automation experience, with strong hands\-on programming experience.
* Programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
* Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks, test libraries, reusable testing components, and automation infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented programming, data structures, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control.
* Experience developing automated tests for APIs, backend services, web applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution, including familiarity with CI/CD runners and build/deployment infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments, with the ability to troubleshoot applications and test environments in the cloud.
* Experience troubleshooting complex application and production issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, and code level debugging.
* Ability to understand an existing codebase and independently build significant automated test coverage.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI assisted development tools/coding agents as part of day to day engineering and test automation work.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply report failures.
* Strong understanding of test automation principles, test design, regression testing, and automation reliability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and cross functional teams.
* Willingness to support production issue reproduction and troubleshooting outside standard working hours when required.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working on enterprise SaaS, IT management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, RMM, or other complex software platforms.
* Deep experience with AWS services and cloud\-hosted, data center hosted, or hybrid environments.
* Experience designing and maintaining large\-scale SDET/DevTest automation frameworks.
* Experience with API automation, integration testing, contract testing, service virtualization, or distributed\-system testing.
* Experience with tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, REST\-assured, pytest, JUnit, TestNG, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including writing queries for test validation and production troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI coding agents to perform tasks such as code generation, test generation, codebase analysis, debugging, refactoring, and test optimization.
* Understanding of application security, scalability, reliability, observability, and distributed\-system behavior.
* Experience building automation capable of operating at significant scale without excessive flakiness or maintenance overhead.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive automation initiatives from design through implementation and production adoption.

title: Senior Recruiting Specialist
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!


Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

 **About Qualys:**


Qualys, Inc. (NASDAQ: QLYS) is a leading provider of disruptive cloud\-based security, compliance and IT solutions with more than 10,000 subscription customers worldwide, including a majority of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100\. Qualys helps organizations streamline and automate their security and compliance solutions onto a single platform for greater agility, better business outcomes, and substantial cost savings. The Qualys Enterprise TruRisk Platform leverages a single agent to continuously deliver critical security intelligence while enabling enterprises to automate the full spectrum of vulnerability detection, compliance, and protection for IT systems, workloads and web applications across on premises, endpoints, servers, public and private clouds, containers, and mobile devices. Founded in 1999 as one of the first SaaS security companies, Qualys has strategic partnerships and seamlessly integrates its vulnerability management capabilities into security offerings from cloud service providers, including Amazon Web Services, the Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure, along with a number of leading managed service providers and global consulting organizations.

 **Role : Sr Recruiting Specialist**

**About the role :**


Qualys is looking for a **hands\-on, high\-impact Sr. Recruiting Specialist** to join our Talent Acquisition team and drive hiring across critical technology functions.

  

This role is for a recruiter who can **speak the language of technology, build talent pipelines from scratch, influence senior hiring managers, and close highly competitive candidates**. You will own complex searches end\-to\-end and bring strong market intelligence, creative sourcing, and a high bar for talent to every hire.

 **Responsibilities :**

* Own **end\-to\-end recruiting** for complex and business\-critical technology roles across Engineering, Cybersecurity, Big Data, Cloud, Product, Business Applications, and Technical Support.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand the **technology, team, and business problem** behind each role and build targeted recruiting strategies.
* Drive **hands\-on, proactive sourcing** through LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, referrals, networking, market research, and competitive intelligence.
* Build and maintain **high\-quality talent pipelines** for both immediate and future hiring needs.
* Assess candidates for **technical capability, career trajectory, motivation, and overall fit**.
* Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers on **talent availability, market trends, compensation, competitive landscape, and hiring strategy**.
* Own candidate engagement and **offer closure**, effectively managing competing offers, counteroffers, compensation expectations, and notice periods.
* Identify and remove hiring bottlenecks, with strong focus on **quality of hire, funnel conversion, time\-to\-fill, and aging requisitions**.
* Leverage **AI and recruiting technology** to improve sourcing, talent intelligence, screening, and recruiting productivity.

**Required Skills**

* **7\+ years of technical recruiting experience**, preferably within SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud, or enterprise technology.
* Proven track record of independently closing **complex, niche, and senior\-level technology roles**.
* Strong technical understanding across areas such as **Software Engineering, Big Data, AI/ML, Cloud, Cybersecurity, QA, and Product**.
* Exceptional **direct sourcing and talent\-mapping** capability; comfortable building pipelines where talent is scarce.
* Strong candidate assessment skills with the ability to distinguish **true technical depth from keyword\-based experience**.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and partner with **senior hiring managers and technical leaders**.
* Strong **negotiation and candidate\-closing** skills.
* Data\-driven approach with understanding of recruiting funnel metrics and hiring performance.
* Highly organized, agile, self\-driven, and comfortable operating in a **high\-growth, high\-accountability environment**.

* Experience hiring for cybersecurity, Big Data, AI/ML, cloud, or other highly specialized technology domains.
* Experience supporting global hiring across India and the US.
* Experience using AI\-powered recruiting tools and talent intelligence platforms.
* Strong technology talent network and knowledge of the competitive SaaS talent market.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**About Kaseya**



Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.



Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.



Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.



We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.



At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

 **Position Summary**



Kaseya is seeking a Staff Software Engineer – DevTest / QA Automation to design, build, and maintain robust automated testing capabilities across enterprise software platforms.



This is a hands\-on software engineering role focused on test automation and engineering quality. The ideal candidate will have a strong programming background and be capable of building test libraries, automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and large scale automated test suites.



The role requires an engineer who can leverage AI assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate automation, analyze existing codebases, generate and validate test scenarios, and rapidly expand automated coverage. The candidate should be comfortable working across application code, test infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and production troubleshooting.



The successful candidate will be able to take an existing codebase and, with limited direction, deliver hundreds of meaningful automated test cases within weeks, while maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks, test libraries, utilities, and reusable automation components.
* Build comprehensive automated test suites for enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, services, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Write production\-quality code to automate functional, integration, regression, API, and system\-level testing.
* Analyze existing application codebases and rapidly identify opportunities for automated test coverage.
* Develop and execute large\-scale automation initiatives capable of delivering hundreds of automated test cases in a short timeframe.
* Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents extensively to accelerate test development, test generation, code analysis, debugging, and automation engineering.
* Validate AI\-generated code and test cases through appropriate engineering practices, including code review, execution, debugging, and test\-result analysis.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and test execution infrastructure.
* Work with CI/CD runners, build systems, deployment pipelines, test environments, and automation reporting.
* Develop automation that can run reliably in continuous integration and deployment environments.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, application issues, environment problems, and production defects using logs, metrics, traces, code, and system behavior.
* Participate in production troubleshooting and issue reproduction, including supporting incidents or reproducing customer issues outside standard working hours when required.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, DevOps, operations, and other QA/DevTest engineers to identify quality risks and improve engineering practices.
* Contribute to improvements in testability, observability, reliability, performance, and maintainability of the product.
* Identify gaps in existing test coverage and proactively create automation to prevent regression.
* Review application and test code and provide technical feedback on quality, maintainability, reliability, and automation effectiveness.
* Continuously improve automation speed, stability, coverage, and execution efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of software engineering, SDET, DevTest, or QA automation experience, with strong hands\-on programming experience.
* Programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar.
* Demonstrated experience building automation frameworks, test libraries, reusable testing components, and automation infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented programming, data structures, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control.
* Experience developing automated tests for APIs, backend services, web applications, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution, including familiarity with CI/CD runners and build/deployment infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments, with the ability to troubleshoot applications and test environments in the cloud.
* Experience troubleshooting complex application and production issues using logs, metrics, traces, database queries, and code level debugging.
* Ability to understand an existing codebase and independently build significant automated test coverage.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI assisted development tools/coding agents as part of day to day engineering and test automation work.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply report failures.
* Strong understanding of test automation principles, test design, regression testing, and automation reliability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineering and cross functional teams.
* Willingness to support production issue reproduction and troubleshooting outside standard working hours when required.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working on enterprise SaaS, IT management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, RMM, or other complex software platforms.
* Deep experience with AWS services and cloud\-hosted, data center hosted, or hybrid environments.
* Experience designing and maintaining large\-scale SDET/DevTest automation frameworks.
* Experience with API automation, integration testing, contract testing, service virtualization, or distributed\-system testing.
* Experience with tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, REST\-assured, pytest, JUnit, TestNG, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, including writing queries for test validation and production troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI coding agents to perform tasks such as code generation, test generation, codebase analysis, debugging, refactoring, and test optimization.
* Understanding of application security, scalability, reliability, observability, and distributed\-system behavior.
* Experience building automation capable of operating at significant scale without excessive flakiness or maintenance overhead.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive automation initiatives from design through implementation and production adoption.

**Additional information**  

*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Life Insurance (Cloud-Native Platforms) - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------


We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance, cloud\-native architecture, and regulated financial services environments. This role is responsible for defining and governing end\-to\-end technology solutions that support insurance products and operations across customer onboarding, policy administration, premium collection, servicing, and claims.
The successful candidate will provide architectural leadership across multiple agile delivery teams, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards. This role combines strategic thinking, hands\-on technical architecture, stakeholder engagement, and insurance domain expertise to deliver future\-ready digital insurance platforms.
Key focus areas include cloud\-native architecture, API\-first design, microservices, event\-driven systems, integration architecture, security\-by\-design, observability, and regulatory compliance within the insurance domain.**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures for Life and Funeral Insurance initiatives, balancing business objectives, technology strategy, cost efficiency, and long\-term sustainability.
* Produce High\-Level Designs (HLDs), detailed solution designs, architecture decision records, integration designs, and supporting architectural documentation.
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and translate strategy into implementable technology solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across multiple agile squads and delivery teams.
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, microservices, and event\-driven architectural approaches.
* Ensure solutions meet key non\-functional requirements including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, availability, and security.
* Lead architecture reviews, governance processes, technology assessments, and design assurance activities.
* Design and govern integrations across policy administration platforms, CRM systems, payment solutions, identity services, and customer engagement channels.
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, risk, compliance, and business teams as a trusted technology advisor.
* Apply FinOps principles to optimise cloud investments and support platform modernisation initiatives.
* Ensure architecture aligns with compliance obligations such as AML, KYC, CDD, EDD, sanctions screening, PEP screening, FICA, POPIA, fraud prevention, audit requirements, and privacy\-by\-design principles.
* Support agile and SAFe delivery practices by providing architectural direction and delivery readiness across releases and programmes.
* Leverage AI\-assisted architecture tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, design exploration, and documentation activities.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5–10\+ years of experience across software engineering and solution architecture.
* 5\+ years of experience designing enterprise\-scale cloud\-native solutions.
* Demonstrated experience within insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.
* Strong expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance products, policy administration, customer journeys, premium collection, servicing, claims, and domain integrations.
* Proven ability to engage with both executive stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience designing cloud architectures, preferably on AWS.
* Strong knowledge of:
	+ Microservices architecture
	+ Event\-driven architecture
	+ REST APIs and API management
	+ Kafka, SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies
	+ Oracle, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases
	+ OAuth2, OpenID Connect, IAM, and security architecture
	+ Observability platforms including CloudWatch, Grafana, ELK, and Dynatrace
	+ CI/CD practices and architecture governance
	+ Agile and ideally SAFe frameworks
* Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, mentoring, and decision\-making skills.
* Preferred certifications:
	+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
	+ TOGAF
	+ SAFe for Architects or equivalent certification
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to shape the future of digital Life and Funeral Insurance platforms serving large customer populations.
* Exposure to business\-critical architecture decisions within a highly regulated financial services environment.
* Collaborative and supportive culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful customer impact.
* Opportunity to work alongside engineering, security, risk, compliance, and business leaders.
* Involvement in cloud transformation and platform modernisation programmes.
* Hybrid working model with regular collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
* Opportunity to influence architecture strategy, governance, and technology adoption at scale.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced cloud\-native architecture and modernisation strategies.
* Enterprise\-scale insurance platform architecture and integration design.
* Financial services regulatory architecture and compliance\-by\-design practices.
* FinOps methodologies and cloud cost optimisation techniques.
* Advanced event\-driven and API\-first architecture patterns.
* Enterprise observability and resilience engineering approaches.
* Architecture governance and decision\-making frameworks.
* AI\-assisted architecture and design acceleration techniques.
* Stakeholder influencing and strategic technology leadership skills.

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

title: Director, Security Engineering - AI
description:
**About Cencora**
-----------------


Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**Role Summary**


The Director, AI Security will build and lead an India\-based AI security engineering and enablement function responsible for protecting enterprise use of artificial intelligence: generative AI, copilots, agents, large language models, machine learning platforms, AI\-enabled SaaS, and AI\-integrated business workflows.


Reporting to the U.S.\-based Senior Director, Data \& AI Security, with a dotted line to the India\-based Senior Director, Endpoint \& Infrastructure Security, this role translates global AI security strategy into scalable engineering, control, and governance outcomes. It is both strategic and technical, and focused on securing AI adoption without blocking innovation while addressing data leakage, prompt injection, model misuse, insecure integrations, shadow AI, agentic workflow risk, and intellectual property exposure.


The role establishes India as a strategic global center of excellence for AI security engineering and operations, not only a delivery location.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Security Strategy and Execution**


Translate enterprise Data \& AI Security strategy into India\-based delivery plans, engineering roadmaps, and measurable objectives.


Lead design and execution of security controls across internally developed models, third\-party AI services, SaaS AI features, copilots, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled automation.


Establish practical AI security patterns that enable innovation while protecting sensitive data, regulated information, credentials, and IP.

 **AI Security Architecture and Engineering**


Lead AI security architecture across enterprise AI platforms, cloud AI services, model integrations, data pipelines, and AI\-enabled applications.


Create and maintain secure design patterns for generative AI platforms, LLM and model API integrations, RAG systems, vector databases and embeddings, AI agents and tool invocation, prompt and response handling, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.


Ensure designs address confidentiality, integrity, availability, identity, data protection, privacy, auditability, resilience, and abuse prevention.

 **AI Risk Management and Control Design**


Define and operationalize controls for prompt injection (direct and indirect), sensitive data leakage, model manipulation and abuse, insecure plugin/tool/agent integrations, unauthorized access through RAG or connectors, excessive agency and unsafe automation, shadow AI, insecure model supply chain, and IP exposure.


Partner with risk, legal, privacy, and compliance to ensure AI controls are practical, enforceable, and measurable.


Partner with Data Security and Privacy on classification, minimization, residency, DLP, encryption and key management, entitlement review, retention, and training and RAG corpus governance — ensuring AI does not create uncontrolled copies, embeddings, or derived data stores outside enterprise governance.

 **Cross\-Domain Control Integration**


Work with the India\-based Senior Director, Endpoint \& Infrastructure Security to embed AI security requirements into endpoint, browser, infrastructure, collaboration, developer, and platform controls.


Drive integration across secure access to AI tools from managed and unmanaged endpoints, endpoint DLP, device posture and conditional access, developer workstation protections for AI\-assisted coding, secrets protection, secure hosting of AI workloads, and AI telemetry.

 **Secure AI Adoption, Assurance, and Operations**


Build practical enablement: AI security intake, risk tiering, assessment templates, control requirements, approved\-tool guardrails, shadow AI discovery, production readiness checklists, and exception models.


Lead or enable AI security testing for prompt injection, RAG data leakage, authorization bypass, connector misuse, unsafe agent actions, excessive permissions, adversarial input, and AI\-generated code risk — in partnership with application security, red team, and model risk.


Partner with cyber defense and the SOC to define AI telemetry, monitoring, and incident response playbooks covering AI tool usage, high\-risk prompt and response patterns, sensitive data movement, connector and agent activity, and shadow AI indicators.

 **Team Leadership and India Capability Building**


Build and lead an India\-based AI security team spanning architecture, engineering, assurance, governance enablement, and technical program management.


Develop a leadership bench and technical career path across AI security architecture, cloud and platform security, application and API security, AI security testing, and automation.

 **Required Experience**


12\+ years in cybersecurity, application security, data security, cloud or infrastructure security, AI/ML security, or related technology risk disciplines.


5\+ years leading technical cybersecurity or security engineering teams.


Strong understanding of generative AI, machine learning platforms, AI\-enabled SaaS, APIs, data pipelines, cloud platforms, and enterprise application architectures.


Experience defining security controls for high\-risk or emerging technology platforms.


Strong understanding of data protection, identity, endpoint, cloud, application, infrastructure, and cyber defense dependencies.


Demonstrated ability to translate emerging technology risk into practical architecture, engineering, and control outcomes.


Ability to lead across geographies, cultures, and time zones, with strong executive\-level written and verbal communication.

 **Preferred Experience**


Securing enterprise AI, generative AI, LLM, or AI\-enabled SaaS platforms, including RAG, vector databases, AI agents, copilots, model APIs, AI gateways, or prompt security controls.


Healthcare, pharmaceutical services, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.


AI governance frameworks, model risk management, privacy engineering, or responsible AI programs.


OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or HITRUST.


Cloud AI services across Azure, AWS, or GCP.


Building a new security capability or establishing India\-based global security capabilities.

 **Key Partners**


AI product and data science teams, enterprise architecture, application and data security, privacy, legal, risk and compliance, cloud/endpoint/infrastructure security, IAM, cyber defense, third\-party risk, and business technology leaders.


.


Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. Master's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience preferred. 10\+ years of experience in security engineering, cybersecurity, information security, technology risk, or a related field required. 5\+ years of experience in a management capacity required. Certification in cybersecurity, cloud security, risk preferred.**What Cencora offers**

title: Assistant Manager_TELECOM BILLING OPERATIONS ENGINEER - PuneVOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.


As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.


We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.


\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this role**
-------------------



We are seeking a Telecom Billing Operations Engineer to provide hands\-on L2 operational ownership of telecom billing platforms and billing\-cycle activities. This role is responsible for ensuring the successful execution of bill runs, invoice processing, call/CDR handling, reconciliation activities, and exception management while maintaining SLA and KPI commitments. The individual will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve billing, rating, mediation and integration issues, contribute to automation and AI\-enabled operational improvements, and support governance, compliance and continual service improvement initiatives. This opportunity is ideal for professionals with 2 to 5 years of Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise billing application operations experience and strong production\-support expertise

**What you will do**
--------------------



Billing Operations \& Bill Run Processing  

* Own the day\-to\-day operational health and technical support of billing processes within the assigned service scope.
* Execute and monitor pre\-bill checks, bill preparation, bill production, bill generation, customer notifications and bill\-cycle closure activities.
* Diagnose and resolve bill\-run failures, rejected accounts, long\-running jobs, capacity constraints, database issues, scheduler failures and billing exceptions.
* Perform post\-bill validations, billed\-account reviews, amount reconciliations and exception tracking to support accurate and timely cycle closure.


Invoice Posting \& Downstream Processing  

* Monitor invoice generation, validation, posting, extraction and delivery to document management, printing and reporting platforms.
* Investigate invoice rejections, posting failures, missing outputs, balance mismatches and data\-quality issues, coordinating service restoration within agreed timelines.


Call / CDR Processing  

* Monitor daily call, event and CDR processing, including rating and re\-rating activities, suspended or rejected records, processing backlogs and delayed usage records.
* Troubleshoot file validation, processing\-chain, sequencing, capacity and data\-quality issues affecting throughput and performance.
* Support record recycling and reprocessing activities to maintain processing accuracy and service continuity.


Discrepancy Management \& Billing Assurance  

* Analyse discrepancies across customer, plan, discount, billing profile, usage, invoice, payment and accounts receivable data.
* Coordinate reconciliations across CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing and downstream systems, ensuring timely resolution of exceptions.
* Identify recurring mismatch patterns and support actions to reduce billing and revenue risks.


Incident, Problem, SLA \& Service Management  

* Lead L2 technical triage and restoration activities for priority billing incidents, engaging specialist support teams and vendors where required.
* Complete root cause analysis, maintain known\-error records and implement corrective actions to reduce recurring issues.
* Monitor SLA and KPI performance, MTTR, backlog levels, operational risks and incident ageing, escalating concerns appropriately.


Automation, AI \& Continual Improvement  

* Develop and enhance automation for health checks, validations, reconciliations, batch monitoring, alerting and operational reporting using Shell scripting, SQL/PLSQL and approved automation platforms.
* Improve monitoring dashboards, proactive alerting capabilities and operational visibility across billing processes.
* Apply approved AI and AIOps capabilities to support anomaly detection, event correlation, incident triage, knowledge retrieval and root cause investigations with appropriate validation controls.
* Contribute to continual improvement initiatives focused on billing accuracy, operational efficiency, reduced manual effort and faster issue resolution.


Operational Governance \& Knowledge Management  

* Provide concise operational status updates covering SLA/KPI performance, bill\-cycle status, incidents, discrepancy trends and improvement activities.
* Maintain runbooks, billing calendars, operating procedures, reconciliation controls, recovery processes, known\-error documentation and audit evidence.

---------------

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.

  

You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open\-ended problem\-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand\-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI\-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.

 **THE WORK**

  

Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:

 **Supply Chain AI Strategy \& Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current\-state processes to AI\-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client\-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain\-specific AI initiatives.
**Client Engagement \& Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client\-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.
**Data \& AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous\-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

  

**BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS**

* 1\.5\- 4years of experience (co\-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field.
* Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics.
* Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level.
* Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting.
* Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI\-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences.
 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* MBA or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Coursework, certifications, or self\-directed learning in AI, machine learning, or data platforms (e.g., cloud certifications, AI/ML specializations).
* Exposure to consulting environments through internships, case competitions, or strategy project work — with demonstrated ability to structure problems and communicate recommendations.
* Familiarity with enterprise planning or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP IBP, o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Oracle SCM) in an academic or professional context.
* Participation in supply chain case competitions, AI hackathons, or strategy projects with measurable outcomes.
* Working knowledge of data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) applied in a supply chain or operations context.
* Understanding of Prompt Engineering or Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques — even at a foundational or experimental level.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Senior Manager - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
**Job Description**


The ideal candidate for a Senior Manager in the Supply Chain team shall be,

* A subject matter expert in application of data science methodologies in one or more areas of supply chain analytics: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Network Design, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, After Market, or Control Tower
* Create new innovative offerings and lead workstreams in their area of expertise; demonstrate thought leadership which helps the growth of the Practice via new client work and more trained team members.
* Support business development and communicate with leaders in client teams to understand business challenges, be the solution architect, design and get buy\-in for the analytics solution and serve as delivery lead of one or more Manager\-led teams during project execution


Job Qualifications

**Experience and Education:**

* Ideal candidates should have a Ph.D. or a Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline like Statistics/ Economics/ Operations Research/Computer Science, etc.
* Work experience in data science applications should be 11\+ years after Master’s degree or 8\+ years after Ph.D., with at least 7 years in advanced analytics solutions design and delivery experience in supply chain/logistics/manufacturing/ production. Global client experience is a plus.
* Certifications in any one or two of the areas will be an added advantage: Python, AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Optimization, Simulation, data science application on any of the cloud platforms (Azure/ GCP/ AWS).

  

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Deep experience in creating innovative solutions and delivering projects using data science in at least one of the supply chain functional areas: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Network Design, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, After Market, or Control Tower
* Expertise in use of data science for supply chain planning and operations of any of the major industries: Consumer Goods, Retail, Life sciences, Industrial, and Resources
* Expert in creating solutions using one or more data science areas like Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistics, Operations Research
* Experience in leading work delivered via large project teams across multiple workstreams
* Strong skills in presentation of complex concepts and large\-scale project work to senior stakeholders
* Hands\-on programming experience with any of the analytics tools, data bases and visualization tools and platforms (e.g., Python, PySpark, SQL)

title: BI Visualisation Development
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 **Business Descriptor:**

**Role purpose**


Drive the delivery of trusted data, actionable analytics and customer lifecycle capabilities for HSBC India’s Brokerage business.


The role will combine data management, business intelligence, customer lifecycle management (CLCM), campaign and marketing execution, and applied data science. The role holder will own the operational flow of customer and campaign data across the lifecycle — from data ingestion and quality controls through segmentation, campaign activation, communication delivery, measurement and optimisation.


The role will work closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Technology to build effective customer funnels, deliver targeted campaigns and improve acquisition, activation, engagement, trading activity, retention and customer value.

**Key responsibilities**

**1\. Customer lifecycle management**

* Define and operationalise customer lifecycle journeys across acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, conversion, retention and reactivation.
* Develop and monitor customer funnels, including sign\-up, onboarding, first transaction, repeat trading, product adoption, engagement and retention.

**2\. Data pipeline setup**

* Manage and monitor data pipelines supporting customer segmentation, campaign triggers, audience creation, delivery and performance measurement.
* Work with Technology and Data Engineering to resolve data\-quality issues, breaks in data movement, latency, reconciliation exceptions and incomplete customer records.
* Manage the operating model and business requirements for brokerage platform \& 3rd party integrations across data ingestion, segmentation, orchestration, campaign execution, reporting and optimisation.

**3\. Campaign design \& performance**

* Set up, coordinate and deliver targeted customer campaigns from brief through to execution, delivery, measurement and optimisation.
* Support campaign orchestration across channels, including push notifications, email, SMS, WhatsApp, mobile and web channels, in\-app messages, web messaging and other approved engagement methods.
* Track delivery metrics, engagement, conversion, incremental uplift, trading activity, retention and return on investment where measurable.

**4\. BI, reporting and business analytics**

* Build and maintain recurring MIS, dashboards and management reporting for Brokerage, Marketing and CLCM performance.
* Reports on acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, trading activity, retention, reactivation, campaign delivery and channel performance.

**5\. Applied data science and AI**

* Contribute to predictive and behavioural analytics, including propensity, churn or retention risk, product affinity and next\-best\-action use cases.
* Support the development and monitoring of analytical models in partnership with relevant data science and technology teams.

**6\. Collaboration, governance and controls**

* Coordinate delivery across internal teams and external vendors, ensuring that dependencies, decisions and actions are clearly documented.
* Support appropriate controls for customer data, consent, audience selection, campaign execution, communication delivery and performance reporting.

**Required skills and experience**

* **7\+ years’ experience** in data, BI, analytics, data science, customer lifecycle management, marketing technology or related roles; BFSI experience is preferred.
* Strong hands\-on SQL capability and experience working with large, complex datasets.
* Working knowledge of Python for analysis, automation and model development is preferred.
